thread:
alex_dev: Heads-up: seeing spike in AER corrected+uncorrected events and NVLink retrains on several H100 hosts in rack-7. Batch latency 2-4x and OOM retries increasing.
monitoring-bot: ALERT: elevated NVLINK_RETRAIN and PCIe_AER resets on pool-usw2-rack7 (nodes: h100-07,h100-09,h100-11). See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/7890
maria_infra: Oncall, can you drop dmesg + nvidia-smi -q and lspci? Also, are these on fw channel stable-2 or staged-2?
alex_dev: Pasting trimmed dmesg and nvidia-smi excerpts now.
```
[Mar 18 09:02:11] pcieport 0000:3b:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id=0001
[Mar 18 09:02:12] pcieport 0000:3b:00.0: PCIe Bus Error: severity=Corrected, type=Physical Layer
[Mar 18 09:02:12] nvidia 0000:3c:00.0: GPU Xid 13: Reset required
[Mar 18 09:02:14] nvlink1: link 1 retraining
[Mar 18 09:10:33] pcieport 0000:3b:00.0: PCIe Bus Error: severity=Uncorrected, type=Transaction Layer
[Mar 18 09:10:33] kernel: pci_bus 0000:3b: bus reset
```
\nNVSMI excerpt:\n```
GPU 00000000:3C:00.0
    Product Name : NVIDIA H100-PCIe
    ECC Errors
        Volatile
            Single Bit ECC Errors : 22
            Double Bit ECC Errors : 0
    XID Errors : 13,61
    NVLINK
        Link 0: Active
        Link 1: Retraining (intermittent)
```

jin_sre: Xid13 usually indicates a reset; Xid61 is often memory parity/ECC. 22 SBE on a single GPU is concerning when paired with physical layer AERs. Could be signal/power. Check BMC events and power sensors.
sam_hardware: If multiple H100s in same rack show it, start with riser/bridge/reseat. Also confirm NVLink bridge part numbers; some vendor bridges had contact issues in earlier batches.
alex_dev: Hosts are all on fw-channel stable-2 (H100 fw v2.2.0). Rack 7 has a shared PDU bank and a single midplane riser vendor (vendor-X).
maria_infra: Immediate mitigation: cordon affected nodes and move high-SLA traffic to dedicated-usw2-b1. I'll trigger an automated failover for paid customer traffic. Note: this will create extra cloud overage ~ $2.5k/day if sustained.
ops-bot: Action: cordon h100-07,h100-09 set by maria_infra at 2026-03-18T09:15Z. CR created: CR-2026-91.

maria_infra: Please collect: `lspci -vvv`, `ipmitool sel list`, `ipmitool sdr`, `cat /sys/kernel/debug/aer/port*` and `ethtool -S` for nvlink interfaces. Also capture full `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,COMMAND` and `udevadm monitor` while reproducing.
alex_dev: Uploaded artifacts to ticket. lspci shows LinkSpeed 8GT/s Width x16 but LnkSta indicates `Training` occasionally.
```
3c:00.0 Class 03:00.0 NVIDIA Device 2204
    LnkSta: Speed 8GT/s, Width x16, TrErr- Train-
```

sam_hardware: Training flag hints at intermittent lane negotiation. Could be thermal/power droop. Any PSU or inlet temp warnings in BMC?
alex_dev: BMC SEL has `PSU2 fan speed low` and two `Temp threshold exceeded` messages 1.5h before spike. Rack has recent noisy workloads but not unusually high.
jin_sre: Correlate timeline: temp warnings => likely power rail instability leading to reduced signal margin causing AERs. Short-term we can disable ASPM on affected hosts and reduce frequency of power state transitions: kernel boot param `pcie_aspm=off` and set NVLink pstate to fixed? Might reduce performance but stabilize.
maria_infra: I'll schedule kernel config change for the cordoned hosts and create an alert to warn if AER counts exceed threshold again. Also escalated to vendor for riser/bridge spare check.
sam_hardware: Plan of record: 1) Reseat NVLink bridges on h100-11 and h100-09, swap riser from h100-07 with known-good riser from spare rack to see if issue follows. 2) Run 30m memory stress + NVLink stress tool to validate. 3) If reproduces, open RMA for riser or GPU depending on which swap follows the fault.
alex_dev: Started reseat on h100-11. After reseat NVLink retrains dropped to 0 on that host for 40m. h100-07 continued to show AER resets after riser swap.
ops-bot: Change request CR-2026-91 updated: riser-swap complete for h100-07, reseat complete h100-11. Assignee: sam_hardware. ETA for replacement parts: 48h.
jin_sre: Because h100-07 kept errors post-swap, it likely is the GPU or PCIe slot on the chassis. Next: put a known-good GPU into the slot and test; if errors persist, chassis riser/backplane needs replacement.
maria_infra: I bumped production routing: shifted 60% of traffic offusw2-rack7 into dedicated pool and degraded batch concurrency automatically. Ops cost: approx $1.8k/day for the current routing changes. Logged to infra spend.
alex_dev: After moving traffic, 99p latency improved to within SLO for other hosts. We'll keep monitoring. I'll collect `nvidia-debugdump` if errors continue.
sam_hardware: If RMA needed, request serials and include `dmesg + lspci + ipmitool sel list + power logs`. Also request expedited shipping due to customer impact.
maria_infra: Communication: sent status note to #incidents and affected customers with ETA 48h for hardware replacement and 4h for initial remediation.
jin_sre: Follow-ups: add AER and ECC SBE counters to host exporter and a composite alert when both metrics trend up within 1h window. Also add power sensor correlation graph for rack-level dashboards.
alex_dev: Update: h100-11 healthy post-reseat. h100-07 marked for replacement; h100-09 under observation. I'll file PMR with vendor including logs. Good triage team. :thumbsup:
